author: norcalboi
quote:
It is a beautiful game, the map is huge, the graphics amazing. But the story is so utterly unfun to play, I don't think I'll ever play this again. 

Jason is incredibly boring, Lucia is a toxic gf that's not even fun, the Bonnie and Clyde story is just not very interesting at all, there are no characters that stand out much, unlike in previous iterations. 

They should have started the game off with a blast, an epic intro to the game that would have also been an amazing welcome back after 13 years of waiting. Instead you start off playing a dating sim. Why?

This game should have been the most over the top, politically incorrect, violent and chaotic satire of American society in the entire franchise. But it is not, and that is so, so, incredibly disappointing.
